card.name: Words just before 'physician' or 'provider'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at, the, or, their, right before a word for the clinician is expected. Typical setting is 'at the discretion of the physician' or 'informed by their physician'.

modes.label: At the discretion of
modes.description: The words 'at' or 'the' inside the phrase 'at the discretion of the physician/prescriber'.
modes.example: the infusion may be slowed or stopped<< at>> the discretion of the physician

modes.label: Other words before clinician
modes.description: Linking words like 'or' or 'their' that lead into physician or healthcare provider.
modes.example: include patient<< or>> care giver error in dosing, healthcare

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward physician, provider or doctor and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a word like physician or provider, especially in 'at the discretion of'.
